solution:
The correct answer is __**1 - a, 2 - d, 3 - c, 4 - b**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Goa** is matched with **Mormugao Port**.
 
• **West Bengal** is matched with **Haldia Port**.
 
• **Tamil Nadu** is matched with **Tuticorin Port**.
 
• **Gujarat** is matched with **Kandla Port**.
 
• Thus, the correct mapping is option 2: 1 - a, 2 - d, 3 - c, 4 - b.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mormugao Port** is one of the leading ports in India located in the state of **Goa**.
 
• **Haldia Port** is a major river port in the state of **West Bengal**.
 
• **Tuticorin Port**, also known as V.O. Chidambaranar Port, is located in the state of **Tamil Nadu**.
 
• **Kandla Port**, now known as Deendayal Port, is located in the state of **Gujarat**.
